description: Source code implementing a sandbox filesystem bridge for OpenShell, including path resolution, file operations, and safety checks.

classes.name: OpenShellFsBridge
classes.description: Implements sandbox filesystem operations such as read, write, delete, rename, and stat within a sandboxed environment, ensuring safety and path resolution.

methods.name: createOpenShellFsBridge
methods.description: Factory function to create an instance of OpenShellFsBridge with provided sandbox and backend.

methods.name: resolvePath
methods.description: Resolves a file path within the sandbox to a sandbox-resolved path object.

methods.name: readFile
methods.description: Reads a file from the sandbox, ensuring path safety.

methods.name: writeFile
methods.description: Writes data to a file within the sandbox, creating directories as needed, with safety checks.

methods.name: mkdirp
methods.description: Creates directories recursively within the sandbox and runs remote mkdir script.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes files or directories within the sandbox, with safety checks and remote removal script.

methods.name: rename
methods.description: Renames/moves files within the sandbox, ensuring safety and executing move via fallback and remote script.

methods.name: stat
methods.description: Retrieves file statistics within the sandbox, with safety validation.

methods.name: ensureWritable
methods.description: Checks if the sandbox path is writable before performing write operations.

methods.name: requireHostPath
methods.description: Ensures the target has a local host path, throws error if not.

methods.name: resolveTarget
methods.description: Resolves a given file path to a sandbox mount point, considering workspace and agent roots.
